question: The Government of India recently renamed the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award as the _________ Khel Ratna Award.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Major Dhyan Chand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**

 
 
• Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award is the highest sporting honour given in India.
 
• The award is named after Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• He was the Prime Minister of India who served from 1984 to 1989.
 
• Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient of this award.
 
• The other Sports Awards include the Arjuna Award, Dronacharya Award and the Dhyan Chand Award, which are conferred every year by the President of India at the Rashtrapati Bhavan on August 29. 
 
• The National Sports Day is celebrated on August 29.
 
• It is the birth anniversary of hockey wizard Dhyan Chand.
